messages:
Evelyn: Hey @Tom, quick question  I added my new partner last month via marriage but realized I used the wrong document for upload. Open enrollment closed so I need to fix this as a QLE. Can I replace the uploaded file?
Tom (People Ops): Congrats, Evelyn! :tada: Yes you can replace docs. Please open your existing Benefits case and upload the corrected file OR reply to the case with the new attachment.
Evelyn: Where's the case? I think it was auto-created but I didn't note the ID.
HR Bot: Automated message: Case #2026-BEN-412 was created on 2026-03-01 for Evelyn regarding "Marriage QLE". Secure upload link: https://benefits.redwood.com/cases/2026-BEN-412/upload
Evelyn: Found it, thanks. I uploaded the certified marriage cert (English) and gov ID.
Tom (People Ops): Received. We'll validate the new docs. Expect review within 3 business days. If everything checks out you'll get an email with the enrollment link (14 days to complete elections).
Marta: FYI if you need dependent-only coverage start date to align with payroll, check the payroll cutoff/update schedule.
Tom (People Ops): Good point. Payroll note: changes approved before 8am PT Thu will apply to the next pay cycle; otherwise premiums may be reflected in the following cycle and prorated back to the QLE date.
Evelyn: One more: I originally forgot to add spouse to dependent life. Can I add that now?
Tom (People Ops): Yes, you can add dependent life as part of the QLE elections. We will email you beneficiary forms after you complete elections.
Evelyn: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Tom (People Ops): Closing loop: once enrollment is finalized, reply here and we'll confirm payroll entries.
